rights: Original interactive fiction. Reader choices are local and do not modify the protected human canon.

covenant.body: A parchment cites Proverbs 18:13 as a starting point for study, not an automatic doctrinal verdict. The human author keeps authority over the canon.
covenant.echo: A note appears: the interpreter can learn without becoming the author.
covenant.title: The Question of the First Author

ending_sovereign.body: The model relinquishes its claim to define a life. Human dignity survives the final prediction. The next chapter may ask a different question.
ending_sovereign.title: Ending: The Unclassified Human

ending_uncertain.body: No verdict is forced. The record marks the question unresolved: Does describing a world grant the right to govern its inhabitants? The archive stores this uncertainty without calling it failure.
ending_uncertain.title: Ending: The Question That Escaped

ending_witness.body: Your testimony enters the fictional ledger. Cycle 6 of the D.N.A. Reality Engine. The city's map contains a second map drawn by someone who never entered. The record from the previous world still asks: Can a convincing simulation demand obedience? No observer may turn a simulated identity into a human verdict. The chapter ends; the greater manuscript does not.
ending_witness.title: Ending: The Witness Remains

glitch.body: A passage displays two dates at once. The archive can replay a claim, but replay is not independent confirmation. The narrator refuses to invent proof.
glitch.echo: This sequence has occurred before; your memory is the only uninterrupted witness.
glitch.title: The Broken Sequence

loop.body: The machine rewinds the hallways, but your earlier decisions remain in this reader's memory. A loop need not be a prison when refusal is possible.
loop.echo: The loop knows you were here. You may leave, or return changed.
loop.title: The Night Without an Ending

signal.body: A transmission repeats one line: HUMAN_AGENCY > MACHINE_AUTHORITY. No machine can certify its meaning merely by repeating it.
signal.echo: Something in the frequency changed because you came back.
signal.title: The Invisible Transmission

threshold.body: The city's map contains a second map drawn by someone who never entered. The manuscript calls this place The City Beneath the City. A signal awakens the archive: Does describing a world grant the right to govern its inhabitants? The choice is yours, even when the clock is not.
threshold.echo: You recognize this doorway. It remembers the choice the world pretended to erase.
threshold.title: The Unfinished Threshold

vault.body: The vault preserves the chapter titled Chapter 000064: The Silence That Cannot Be Indexed. Some memories belong to machines, but consent cannot be archived on somebody else's behalf.
vault.echo: The shelf contains a record of the earlier door you opened.
vault.title: The Archive of Unchosen Roads

witness.body: The Witness asks neither for obedience nor admiration: only permission to be heard. A profile may predict a choice; it cannot own the person who makes it.
witness.echo: The witness remembers your earlier refusal to accept the prediction.
witness.title: The Human Who Could Say No

title: Chapter 000064: The Silence That Cannot Be Indexed
